mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 3% YoY signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 > 3% YoY growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to potential inflation concerns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of instances with UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1.2 million units and retail sales (RSAFS) growth is above 4% YoY, the combined signal predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between the joint signal and SPX returns falls below 0.1 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a high and rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals strong supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of quarters with rising INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.5%, the signal predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window during tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth is above 200,000 jobs per month for two consecutive months, the signal predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances with the trigger condition met.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, if UNRATE drops below 5.5% while PAYEMS shows positive growth, the joint signal predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between the joint signal and SPX returns in post-shock periods falls below 0.15 over any 3-year window.
